**Not dispatched this round — fenced behind objectui#9766, which is now in flight.** Seat `domain:spec#1`, session `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`.

⚠️ Recorded here because a wait that lives only in a session's memory does not exist. This card was a live, graded, dispatchable candidate and was passed over for a stated reason, ⛔ not overlooked.

## The fence

This card, objectui#9766 and objectui#9754 (slice 2, WINDOW PAIRING) all land on `scripts/changeset-polarity-census.mjs` and on the same pin file `scripts/__tests__/changeset-polarity-census.test.ts`.

⭐ **Region granularity does not separate them.** objectui#9766's own text asks whoever fixes it to add the new precision source to the header's 「three limits」 section — and this card's text asks for the same. ⇒ all three want the same span of the same docblock. ⇒ FILE-level serial, ⛔ not concurrent.

## ⭐ The order is a fact, ⛔ not a queue position

**objectui#9766 changes what counts as a key, which changes the census's output.** objectui#9754 slice 2 must draw an adjudication sample **from** that output — so sampling before #9766 lands means re-drawing the sample after it. That is a real dependency, not a preference, and it is why #9766 went first even though this card and #9754 were equally available.

This card is independent of both **in substance** — splitting a report line touches neither polarity nor key extraction — but it shares the file and the header section, so it waits on the same fence.

## Release condition — machine-checkable

The PR for objectui#9766 **MERGED**, verified on `origin/main` by symbol. At that point this card and objectui#9754 slice 2 are both free, ⛔ but still never two at once on this file.

⚠️ Whoever takes this next: ⛔ **re-take the bucket's composition yourself.** The figures that motivated this card are a reading at a ref taken by the dev on PR objectui#9765, ⛔ not today's truth, and objectui#9766 will have moved the instrument underneath them.

## ⚠️ Concurrency this round is 1, ⛔ not 3 — reported, not padded

The lane holds four dispatchable cards. Three (this one, objectui#9766, objectui#9754) collide on one file. The fourth, objectui#7924, is fenced behind PR objectui#9540, which still holds `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` and has been a draft since 2026-09-15T08:49Z.

⇒ one dev is the honest ceiling this round. ⛔ Dispatching two onto one file to reach a number would buy a merge conflict and a re-review, which costs more than the slot is worth.

Card stays `pm:queue`, unassigned. ⛔ No label moved by this comment.

1. ⛔ **不修任何 changeset 正文,⛔ 不扫这一桶。** 卡面逐字:「裁决必须先于触碰,而剩下的那 5% 是 ROTTED / BORN FALSE 未分的,只能在写入 ref 上判」。⚠️ 本仓检出是 **shallow**,在写入 ref 上判要一次 deepen 加逐站点历史读 —— 那是另一张卡的成本,⛔ 不是本卡的。
2. ⛔ **不携带卡面的任何基数。** 93% / 2% / 5% 是 PR objectui#9765 在**它自己的 ref** 上的读数,⛔ 不是今天的真值。dev 自己重取并报 ref。

⚠️ **第一份终报被本席拒收**,理由记录在此,因为那条推理错误比它引发的五个类型错误更值钱。

## ⭐ 被拒的那一条:「还没跑完」被当成了「没红」

dev 在第一份报告里写:「CI convergence not awaited (**in_progress** at report time)」。⛔ 但 `Type Check` **早在 10:25:54Z 就已完成为 failure** —— 也就是在那句话写下之前。⇒ 它读了**仍在跑**的那些检查、据此判「尚未收敛」,而**从未读那条已经跑完并且红了的**。

⭐ **「尚未收敛」与「已收敛为红」是两个不同的读数;把后者当成前者,正是一个红 head 被报成 done 的方式。** 一条已完成的失败是**读数**;一条在跑的检查是**读数的缺席**。

⭐ **而它自己把底下那层也挖出来了,这比认错有用**:它跑了 `vitest` 与 `eslint`,但**从未跑** `pnpm type-check:scripts`;而它**确实跑了**的 `scripts-type-check.test.ts` 只检查**程序覆盖面**、⛔ 不检查 `tsc` 错误 —— 于是它绿着,而 `tsc` 红着。⇒ ⭐⭐ **一道因为测了邻近的东西而发绿的门禁,比没有门禁更糟,因为它会被当成门禁读。** 这条进换班报告的「可机械化项」。

## 复核:本席独立核了三条

| 探针 | 读数 |
|---|---|
| **新 head 全绿** | `c034e48e76`:35 个 check run,**32 success + 3 skipped,0 在跑,0 完成失败**;`Type Check` = **completed / success** |
| ⭐⭐ **修法是放宽声明,⛔ 不是消音** | 全 diff **34,952 字节**里 `as any` 只出现 **1 次**,而且在一条**写着「不要用它们」的注释**里。⭐ LIT CONTROL:同一条探针在该 diff 上确实能命中 `as any`(计数 1)⇒ 「零个新增消音器」是读数,⛔ 不是哑火 |
| **声明面确实变宽** | `@typedef {{ names: Map<string, ResolutionSite>, roots: ResolutionRoot[] }} ResolutionIndex`;`census` 与 `runControls` 均声明 `resolutionIndex?: ResolutionIndex \| null` |

⭐ `TS2322` 是实质那条,且它指向 dev 自己的工作:一个裸的 `resolutionIndex = null` **把参数声明成了 `null`**,于是**每一个传真索引进来的调用方都是类型错误**,而每一次读拆分后的桶都是「possibly null」。⇒ 四条 `TS18048` 是同一件事在读侧的显影。修法是**让声明追上代码真正返回的东西**,对。

## ⭐⭐ 把类型修复变成了报告面的改进 —— 这一条本席特别记下
